title: Julius Evola stayed with the SS to the end of the war

tellings.quote: No, he stayed with the SS till the end of the war. >> Oh interesting. He had access to their libraries and they let him have it.

plain: The Italian writer Julius Evola is said to have stayed with the SS until the end of the war, and the SS reportedly let him use their libraries. The researcher Peter Levenda tells Michels this without naming a source, as part of a longer talk about esoteric thinkers close to the Nazis.
